title: Frozen Pizzas (Jack's, Red Baron, or Any Freezer Pizza)
description: How to bake frozen pizzas, including 3 Jack's at once.

ingredients.note: Jack's, Red Baron, or any freezer pizza

steps: Follow the box temperature and time. Use regular Bake mode for frozen pizza (Air Fry mode can burn the top before the crust is done).
Bake directly on the rack for a crisp crust, or on a sheet pan for a softer one.
3 Jack's at once: use 2 racks, swap racks and turn the pizzas halfway, and add 2 to 4 min. Or bake 2, then the third while you eat.
Done when cheese is bubbling and the crust edge is golden. Rest 2 min before cutting.
Red Baron personal pizza: follow the box (oven, or microwave with the crisping tray if the box has one). Don't have it? Any freezer pizza, follow its box.
source: Joe's Meal Pack, Oct 20 to Nov 4, 2026 (built by Thrifty, now kept by Meal Plan), R6

healthy: Quick and portion controlled if you stick to a serving.
Cheese gives some protein and calcium.
not_healthy: Frozen pizzas are high in sodium.
Cheese and processed meat toppings add saturated fat.
